Tesla Teases New Roadster Ahead of Reveal

Tesla has released a new teaser for its upcoming Roadster high-performance EV, while also announcing significant updates for its Semi truck. The teaser showcases what seems to be an LED light bar at the front of the vehicle. Tesla’s post simply stated, "See you next week," hinting at the much-anticipated reveal.
US Airlines Resist More China-US Flights
Airlines for America, a trade group representing airlines such as
, has urged the Trump administration to reject additional China-US flights. The group warns that such a move could create competitive gaps for US airlines.

Gary Black’s Take on Legacy Automakers and Tesla’s FSD
Investor Gary Black has stated that legacy automakers such as
will not license Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology. Black has long predicted that no legacy automakers would license Tesla’s FSD technology.
Tesla’s FSD Exceeds Speed Limits in Brussels Tests

Tesla’s Full Self-Driving system was found to have exceeded the legal speed limit on 55% of the Brussels road segments in a recent test. This comes less than two weeks before a potential EU vote that could determine how widely the system can operate across Europe.
